ios.desc:
A thoughtful mood check-in, right on your Apple Watch.

Aura makes it easy to notice how you feel without turning reflection into a chore. Choose a mood in seconds, or add context when you want a richer record.

BUILT FOR QUICK MOMENTS
• Check in with one tap
• Add feelings, life context, and an optional note
• Receive gentle, encouraging responses that vary with your recent history

SEE THE PATTERN
• Review your recent check-ins in one clear history
• See a 30-day mood view and simple personal insights
• Add or edit details later
• Remove individual entries or Aura-created data whenever you choose

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH
• A fully independent watch app—no iPhone companion required
• Complications provide a quick glance and fast way back to Aura
• Native SwiftUI controls, haptics, and accessibility support

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Aura saves each check-in as a State of Mind entry in Apple Health. It does not create a separate mood database, require an account, show ads, or send your feelings to a server. Health access is always your choice and remains under your control.

Aura is a reflection tool, not a medical device, and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.
